headlines.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures mixed amid volatile week
headlines.summary: Stocks futures were mixed on Friday, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq on track for weekly losses, capping a volatile week.

headlines.title: Netflix is dealing with a generational streaming shift away from the living room
headlines.summary: Netflix (NFLX) will be cutting 6% of its workforce — or 1,000 jobs — keeping in trend with other media giants who have also reduced their headcount. Piper Sandler director and senior research analyst Tom Champion comes on Market Domination to speak more on how Netflix is dealing with the generational streaming and content shift away from the living room, especially as creator content dominates viewership.

headlines.title: Netflix Floundered by 20% This Year: One Analyst Says Its Streaming Monopoly WIll Net 88% Gains Within a Year
headlines.summary: Netflix keeps posting double-digit revenue growth while its stock craters toward a 52-week low, and the gap between Wall Street's most bearish and most bullish analysts has rarely been this wide. Something has to give, and the next earnings report could force a verdict.

headlines.title: Netflix Shares Fall 2% as Peter Rice Replaces Bela Bajaria as Chief Content Officer
headlines.summary: Netflix (NASDAQ:NFLX) shares declined 2% in premarket trading on Friday, 16 October 2026, after the streaming company announced the appointment of Peter Rice as its new Chief Content Officer, replacing Bela Bajaria. Rice, a former Chairman of Walt Disney Television, will join Netflix on 26 October.

headlines.title: What Netflix (NFLX)'s 1,000 Job Cuts Mean For Shareholders
headlines.summary: Netflix has announced its largest layoffs since 2022, cutting about 1,000 roles, or 6% of staff, mainly across product, technology, legal and HR, while stating that the business remains financially strong and focused on high impact areas. The cuts reshape Netflix’s cost base at the same time as it leans into advertising, live events, sports and gaming, so investors are watching how lower overhead might interact with heavy content and ad tech spending commitments.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
